name: @skills-manager/utils
description: Shared, runtime-agnostic ESM utilities for all Skills Manager apps (Workers-safe).

scripts.build: (node -e "import('node:fs').then(f=>f.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}))" || true) && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/cn.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --packages=external --outfile=dist/cn.js && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --emitDeclarationOnly
